title: Text: DET Greg Garno ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Tigers Add Top Prospects, Some Of The Greatest Prospects, To 40-Man Roster
Is this obvious enough, or do I have to change “Top” to “Tremendous”
Change it to Tremendous.

Also, according to Brent, Ron was apparently fuming about you while he was in Portland and said “he was on a mission to get you fired.” Now I want to stress that was a joke, according to Brent. And the context was more “Jesus, he’s on my nerves” but it’s still funny.
My gosh lol
Again, that’s not a real threat and not a real “I’m gonna make sure this guy is fired”
Oh yeah didn’t they go on some marketing trip together?
Also, announcement will come sometime after 4. Those players I sent you are the confirmed list
